text:
Kevin: Hey team — Escalation from AcmeCorp. Invoice INV-2026-03-10 shows ~12k tokens billed but their dashboard shows ~3.2k for the same day. They say this happens only for SSE streaming sessions where the client cancels mid-generation. Can we triage?

Maria: Ack, can you paste the customer session id + rough timestamps? Also their dashboard screenshot would help.

Kevin: Session id: sess_9a7b. Customer timeline: connect 10:12:03, cancel 10:12:11, invoice timestamp 2026-03-10T10:12Z. They attached a snippet of server connection logs: ```
[10:12:03.112] sse: accept conn_id=abc123 session=sess_9a7b
[10:12:05.234] gen: chunk sent tokens=284 event=chunk
[10:12:11.001] conn: client closed connection (rst)
[10:12:11.120] gen: finalize emitted tokens=284 event=final
[10:12:11.350] replay: finalize emitted tokens=10240 event=final
```

Maria: whoa that replay line looks suspicious. @sophie_eng can you weigh in on whether replay/fallback finalizes would ever be re-attributed to the same session? :thinking:

Sophie: Thanks — initial read: if a client aborts midstream we emit an abort/finalize to close the KV cache and persist partial tokens, but under certain race conditions a background retry/replay may also emit a second finalize record that gets picked up by billing. We fixed a related path for dedicated in 2025 but might have missed a corner in hosted SSE. Need request_ids to correlate ledger events.

Kevin: Provided the request ids from the logs: req=R-7f2, req=R-7f2-replay (same session). Customer says they did a quick reconnect within 500ms.

Jon: Filing initial billing triage: there's a known pattern where a replay finalize emitted within the same 2s window gets double-counted in the invoice join. I've created a short investigation: INV-4321. @billing-bot can you link the invoice and mark P1? :eyes:

billing-bot: Investigation INV-4321 created and linked to INV-2026-03-10. Priority set to P1.

Sophie: For repro: simulate SSE connect -> start streaming -> client-side close -> immediate reconnect and force server-side replay. If we reproduce, fix tracks two areas: 1) ensure replay finalizes are idempotent (dedupe by replay_id) and 2) adjust billing join to prefer the later non-replay finalize when both exist.

Maria: Customer wants a quick credit if confirmed. What's the runbook for identifying affected invoices?

Sophie: Quick query we use in infra: ```sql
SELECT invoice_id, session_id, event_type, tokens, timestamp
FROM meter_events
WHERE session_id = 'sess_9a7b'
AND event_type IN ('finalize','replay_finalize')
ORDER BY timestamp;
```
If you see two finalize rows (one with small tokens and one with large replay tokens) that's the pattern.

Jon: If repro holds, billing will issue credit and ops will push a hotfix to de-dupe. Target: patch + deployed in 48h. For now, support can proactively issue a provisional credit.

Kevin: Thanks — I'll update AcmeCorp and attach the ticket. Will also grab sample traces and S3 blobs for Sophie.

Maria: Thanks team :thumbsup:
